mapper.insert:
insert ignore into third_party_bill( bill_no, order_id, channel, channel_trade_no, bill_type, amount, bill_status, bill_time, raw_line, create_time, update_time ) values
( #{item.billNo}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.channel}, #{item.channelTradeNo}, #{item.billType}, #{item.amount}, #{item.billStatus}, #{item.billTime}, #{item.rawLine}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select count(1) from third_party_bill tb left join payment_flow pf on pf.order_id = tb.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'PAY' left join refund_flow rf on rf.order_id = tb.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'REFUND' where (tb.bill_type = 'PAY' and pf.id is null) or (tb.bill_type = 'REFUND' and rf.id is null)

select tb.id, tb.bill_no, tb.order_id, tb.channel, tb.channel_trade_no, tb.bill_type, tb.amount, tb.bill_status, tb.bill_time, tb.raw_line, tb.create_time, tb.update_time from third_party_bill tb left join payment_flow pf on pf.order_id = tb.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'PAY' left join refund_flow rf on rf.order_id = tb.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'REFUND' where (tb.bill_type = 'PAY' and pf.id is null) or (tb.bill_type = 'REFUND' and rf.id is null) order by tb.bill_time asc limit #{limit}
